text: Swimming is an enjoyable and advantageous form of physical exercise. The primary method of swimming is lapping, which entails swimming in a circular motion. This activity enhances muscular strength and velocity. Following the initial lapping stage, goggles can be worn. Goggles are specialized swimming glasses designed to safeguard the eyes while swimming. There are a variety of styles and colors to choose from. Thus, if you wish to engage in swimming and partake in amusement, it is advisable to commence with lapping and then put on goggles in a subsequent stage.
